answer: Witnessed Voyage Ledger. Each identity must complete one physical voyage between two fixed ports, confirmed by hardware beacons at both ends and a signed mid-route ledge checkpoint. A single operator cannot occupy two hulls at once, so every extra identity needs a real vessel, crew, and fuel. Each fake identity thus costs one full voyage plus beacon hardware, making mass duplication physically self-defeating while the hollow middle of the route stays unrecorded and unspoofable.
